notes: s013 Πατέρα takes the whole supplied to our father; the unit note records that reading to as licensed by ἔχομεν remains defensible.
s025 is emptied by the demonstrative these under rule 38, and the articles before Ἀβραάμ and θεός are unrepresented under rule 23 for want of an English determiner.
s008 μή is an ordinary negative aligned to not: no negative indefinite stands to absorb it, so rules 41 and 59 are not in play.
